```yaml
name: NPM Publish

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version-file: ".node-version"
          cache: "pnpm"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Set npm dist-tag
        id: set-dist-tag
        run: echo "::set-output name=dist-tag::$(if [[ $GITHUB_REF == *prerelease ]]; then echo 'next'; else echo 'latest'; fi)"

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: pnpm publish --access public --tag ${{ steps.set-dist-tag.outputs.dist-tag }}
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
```
